# Huawei Cloud FunctionGraph: scheduled timer trigger creation

Curated by Skill Harbor — @huaweicloud's official skill for creating scheduled TIMER triggers on Huawei Cloud FunctionGraph: Quartz Cron (and fixed-rate) scheduling via a bundled Python script, a parameter-confirmation checklist, the full Cron expression reference, verification steps (status, next execution, history), and best practices (UTC timezone, ≥5-min intervals, least-privilege IAM, Cloud Eye alarms). Honest caveats: requires a Huawei Cloud account with Access/Secret keys in environment variables, an existing FunctionGraph function, and the FunctionGraph SDK; function executions are billed per invocation (trigger configuration itself is free); max 10 triggers per function. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
